mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% triggers increased consumer confidence and corporate investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE ≥ 5.0% or the 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05 in t-test), the mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) creates dual positive momentum in economic activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If either GDPC1 ≤ 15000 or UNRATE ≥ 5.0%, the 60d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in the CPIAUCSL index above 2.0 signals accelerating inflation, prompting market anticipation of rate hikes and reduced corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL ≤ 2.0, the 20d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the regime is not a late-cycle expansion or FEDFUNDS does not decline, the 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above 103.6585 indicates expanding industrial activity, boosting consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO ≤ 103.6585, the 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in HOUST above 1001.0 indicates heightened demand for housing, boosting construction sector activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST ≤ 1001.0, the 5d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an unexpected decline in FEDFUNDS signals premature easing, creating market uncertainty but also lower borrowing costs, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the regime is not a tightening cycle or FEDFUNDS does not decline, the 60d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05 in t-test).
